meaning.en: Any of a family of polymers derived from vinyl chloride: they have many uses in various forms, as in rigid plastic pipes and clear, thin food wrapping.
meaning.vi: Bất kỳ họ polyme nào có nguồn gốc từ vinyl clorua: chúng có nhiều công dụng ở nhiều dạng khác nhau, chẳng hạn như trong các ống nhựa cứng và gói thực phẩm mỏng, trong suốt.

meaning_vi: của polyvinyl chloride nhựa PVC (một loại chất dẻo)

sentences.en: Existing hard flooring such as PVC Composition tiles (including bitumen based ' Marley ' tiles) Tile may be left in place.

sentences.en: Here they consist of stranded conductors twisted together and housed in a PVC covering.

sentences.en: These are carried by tubing, usually PVC coated 1/4 or 3/8 inch diameter copper tubing.

sentences.en: Permanent buoyancy is provided using soft PVC closed-cell foam or polyethylene that is placed in layers inside a durable outer cover.

sentences.en: Heck nowadays you can get organic lube and even the ubiquitous ' Rabbit ' is being made from thermoplastic elastomers instead of PVC.

sentences.en: A neat touch, typical of Citroen, is a reversible boot mat with carpet on one side and washable PVC on the other.

sentences.en: Contrary to what certain books say mine has the moquette trim in the rear and not pvc.
